title: Build trans-planar polysilane geometries
action: Construct atomic coordinates and lattice vectors for trans-planar (SiH2)n and (SiHMe)n chains using bond lengths from Phillips rationalized radii (Si-Si 2.34 Å, Si-C 1.94 Å, Si-H 1.54 Å, C-C 1.54 Å, C-H 1.09 Å). Assign point-group symmetries (D2h for (SiH2)n, C2h for (SiHMe)n). Define the unit cell and basis of atomic orbitals (Si 3s,3px,3py,3pz; C 2s,2px,2py,2pz; H 1s).
description: Generates the structural input for the tight-binding calculation. Evidence records the final coordinates and symmetry assignments.

title: Compute interatomic LCAO matrix elements
action: For each polysilane model, compute interatomic Hamiltonian matrix elements between valence orbitals using the Harrison-Froyen formula V_{ll'm} = ζ_{ll'm} ℏ²/(m d²). Use the universal ζ coefficients (Vssσ, Vspσ, Vppσ, Vppπ) from the Harrison reference. Include non-nearest-neighbor interactions.
description: Produces the hopping parameters required for the secular equation. Evidence file records the computed matrix elements.

title: Solve Slater-Koster secular equation at Γ and extract band gap and symmetries
action: Form the Slater-Koster Hamiltonian at the Γ-point (k=0) using the computed matrix elements and the corrected atomic on-site energies: ε_{3s}(Si)=8.0 eV, ε_{3p}(Si)=-2.0 eV, ε_{2s}(C)=-11.5 eV, ε_{2p}(C)=-8.0 eV, ε_{1s}(H)=-12.0 eV. Diagonalize to obtain eigenvalues and eigenvectors for each of the four model compounds: (SiH2)n, (SiHMe)n, (SiHPh)n, and (SiMePh)n. Determine the direct band gap as the difference between the lowest unoccupied and highest occupied molecular orbitals (LUMO and HOMO). Identify the irreducible representations of the HOMO and LUMO by projecting the eigenvectors onto the appropriate point group's character table (D2h for (SiH2)n, C2h for the others). Write the results for all four compounds to results.json.
description: Final scored artifact containing the direct band gap and symmetry labels for the band edges of four polysilane model compounds: (SiH2)n, (SiHMe)n, (SiHPh)n, and (SiMePh)n. The checker compares the reported values to hidden reference values from the paper.
output_schema: JSON array with four objects, one for each compound. Each object has keys: compound (string, one of 'SiH2', 'SiHMe', 'SiHPh', 'SiMePh'), direct_gap_eV (float, the band gap in eV), vbm_symmetry (string, irreducible representation of the valence band maximum), cbm_symmetry (string, irreducible representation of the conduction band minimum).
